methods.name: Sea Slug quest skip
methods.note: Sea Slug alone takes you from 1 to 24. Fishing Contest and Freeing Pirate Pete bring the total to 10,612 XP, level 27.

methods.name: Fly fishing
methods.note: Trout and salmon with a fly rod and feathers, dropping the catch. Barbarian Village has a fire for cooking. 3-tick nearly doubles the rate.

methods.name: Tempoross
methods.note: Mass worlds, not cooking the harpoonfish, regular harpoon. Low effort and rewards the fish barrel. A crystal harpoon reaches 95,000 at 99.

methods.name: Aerial fishing
methods.note: Lake Molch with a cormorant. Splits XP with Hunter and needs no drift nets. Rates assume Hunter rises alongside Fishing.

methods.name: Drift net fishing
methods.note: Underwater off Fossil Island, chasing shoals into nets. Best combined Fishing and Hunter XP. Uses about 115 drift nets an hour.

methods.name: Barbarian fishing
methods.note: Otto's Grotto with a barbarian rod and feathers, dropping the fish. Passive Agility and Strength XP. Fly fishing is faster until 58.

methods.name: Barbarian fishing (3-tick)
methods.note: Tick-perfect 3-tick with herb and tar or cut-eat. Both guides use it as the fast route from 58. Very click-intensive.

methods.name: Monkfish
methods.note: Piscatoris with a small net, banked for profit. With 75 Sailing the offshore spot never moves, 3 to 4 minutes per inventory.

methods.name: Karambwan
methods.note: Fairy ring DKP with a vessel and karambwanji. Spots never move, so an inventory is hands-off. Rates assume a fish barrel and banking.

methods.name: Deep sea trawling
methods.note: Sloop with two trawling nets following shoals, also gives Sailing XP. Linen nets need 65 Sailing, cotton 84. Rates are provisional.

methods.name: Leechfin
methods.note: Vampyrium river with a big net, a click every tick and dropping between waves. Fast with no tick manipulation. Assumes angler outfit.

methods.name: Infernal eels
methods.note: Inner Mor Ul Rek, so you must own a fire cape. Oily rod, bait and ice gloves. Low effort, profit from tokkul and bolt tips.

methods.name: Minnows
methods.note: Fishing Guild platform, needs the full angler outfit. Minnows trade for noted raw sharks at 40 each. Spots move every 15 seconds.

methods.name: Anglerfish
methods.note: Port Piscarilius with sandworms. The offshore boat spot never moves, 6 to 7 minutes per inventory. Diabolic worms roughly double the rate.

unverified: Sea Slug quest skip: quest XP is a one-off, so no hourly rate; neither guide gives a non-quest method below level 20
Fly fishing: main guide AFK column used (13,000 to 50,000); the Ironman Guide says 20,000 to 35,000
Tempoross: regular harpoon, not cooking, mass worlds; dragon harpoon is 66,000 to 74,000 and crystal 77,000 to 95,000 from 70; the Ironman Guide quotes 50,000 an hour solo

Aerial fishing: table rows pair Fishing 43/56/73/91/99 with Hunter 35/51/68/87/99; Hunter training gives a different Hunter range (25,000 to 80,000) than this table (39,600 to 123,466), and the table's total at 73 does not add up

Barbarian fishing: guides disagree without tick manipulation at 99 (57,000 main, 65,000 to 71,750 ironman) and with it (108,000 main, 104,000 to 114,800 ironman); main guide used. Agility and Strength 30 is the leaping salmon requirement at 58; the trout requirement at 48 is not stated. Barbarian Training (miniquest) must be started
Karambwan: main guide (with fish barrel) 29,000 to 42,000 used; the Ironman Guide gives 22,500 to 33,850 without barrel or outfit

Deep sea trawling: the wiki flags these rates as incomplete and possibly pre-dating the May 2026 trawling changes; bands mix net tiers (rope with bait at 69, linen at 73 and 83, cotton at 87); no rates for yellowfin (79) or marlin (91); Sailing levels for nets come from Sailing training
Leechfin: table is stated as maximum efficiency with the angler outfit, taken as written
Infernal eels: fire cape requirement cannot be expressed in req
Minnows: full angler outfit requirement cannot be expressed in req
Anglerfish: no sandworm rate above level 90; diabolic worms give 30,000 at 82 and 39,000 at 99; the Ironman Guide says 15,000 to 18,000 at the boat spot

Left out to stay within 14: 2-tick harpooning (tick manipulation, 101,800 to 132,800 with crystal harpoon from 71), dark crabs (about 40,000 from 85, deep Wilderness), sacred eels (20,000 to 23,000 from 87)
